container._comment: Was nested under `grids.container` — the pipeline emitted --origam-grids__container---* while OrigamContainer.vue reads --origam-container---* under its own name (issue #417 / #508). Split into its own top-level file so the emitted prefix matches the component. max-width-{sm,md,lg,xl,xxl} are carried over unchanged; OrigamContainer.vue currently sets its breakpoint max-widths as SCSS literals (900/1200/1800/2400px) rather than reading these, a separate gap left open — see report.

border._comment: useBorder(props) toggles the `origam-container--border` class (a state modifier, not a BEM child) when the `border` prop is truthy. Marked with $state (issue #435 mechanism) because the bare key `border` is not in TOKEN_INTENT_STATES and would otherwise flatten to a __border BEM child no component asks for. OrigamContainer.vue read this var with NO fallback (issue #405, 'sans repli') — border-width/box-shadow simply never applied. Values chosen to match the established 'enable a border' convention used elsewhere (Avatar, Drawer, Sheet): a thin border, no added elevation.
